description: Needs an admin key, a write key gets forbidden. Erase guest data for a venue, by guest id or owner principal. A guest id erases the guest record, every reservation linked to it, and the venue's waitlist entries with the same contact. An owner principal erases the reservations it owns and the guest records left with no other visit. A guest id that is not a record is read as a contact, which is deprecated. Returns counts of erased reservations, guest records, and waitlist entries. Takes no idempotency key. A retry erases nothing more and reports 0 for what the first call erased.

guestId.description: Guest record id from a reservation's guest.guestId. A contact still works for one version and is deprecated.

name: reservation.erasure
title: Erase personal data
